c_from_a_city.text: He came from the east, from somewhere with a working hospital — a city that still runs.

c_same_makers.text: Whoever marked him also made our crates and our records. Cistern 9 and his city share an owner.

c_photo_made.text: The photograph was never taken. Something made it — and made it of me.

c_cisterns_city.text: The cisterns belong to the city. It kept us to spend us, on a schedule; MOTHER has been refusing the schedule for thirty years.

c_mother_answers.text: MOTHER has been answering someone outside for years — and the answer has always been no.

c_same_water.text: Shale's water is run from the same network that feeds the Cistern — by someone who changes the schedule from far away.

c_stranger_route.text: He came west through Shale with nothing left to trade but a ring, and went to the Rust Dogs on purpose.

c_list_of_names.text: The map is a list of people, with places and dates, that someone paid men to stop him carrying west. He carried it to us anyway.

c_held_at_a_number.text: Shale is not short of water. It is being held at a number, by a schedule somebody east writes.

c_same_hand_everywhere.text: The Cistern's records, the pump manual and the Dry Wells log are all kept in one hand. One keeper.

c_fed_from_outside.text: The Cistern was built to be collected. Its water comes from outside, and so, one day, will its people's orders.

c_dead_numbers.text: The Sink's drowned go on living in the city's file: their numbers come up the stair each spring and are sold to people who need to be someone the lens has not seen.

c_rev_last_day.text: The stranger walked out of the city's highest house with twelve faces under his coat, and somebody at the gate already knew to wait for him on the road.

c_static_source.text: The city reads itself its own file on the lamp wire every night at two; a kiosk spliced to it sells the names as fortunes, and a girl who slept against a lift shaft says them as prophecy. Whoever listens right is a forecast.

c_photo_forecast.text: The photograph is a forecast: a portrait of who the file expects me to become, rendered, not taken.

c_crown_sold.text: The Crown is selling itself downriver: the bridge's near end and the Committee's forecasts both go to the Concern by the Long Night, by the same house.
